div.head: Wif 8
div.ab: Æt ðam giftan sceal mæssepreost beon mid rihte, se sceal mid Godes bletsunge heora gesomnunge gederian on ealre gesundfulnesse.
Huic dationi debet interesse presbiter, qui cum Dei benedictione debet eorum consortium adunare in omnem sanitatem.
Æt þam giftan sceal mæssepreost beon mid rihte, se sceal mid Godes bletsunge heora gesomnunge gederian an ealre gesundfulnesse.
At the marriage there should by rights be a mass-priest, who shall unite them together with God's blessing in all prosperity.
Bei der Trauung soll von rechtswegen der Priester sein: der soll durch Gottes Segen ihre Vereinigung zusammenthun in aller Heilsamkeit.
At the wedding a mass-priest shall by right be present, who shall unite their union with God's blessing in all prosperity.
